ayahs.textUthmani: صٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: صٓ‌ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ ۝١
ayahs.textIndopak: ص࢜ وَالْقُرْاٰنِ ذِي الذِّكْرِ ؕ
ayahs.translation: Ṣād.[1316] By the Qur’ān containing reminder...[1317]
ayahs.transliteration: Saaad; wal-Qur-aani thith thikr

footnotes.1317: The completion of the oath is understood to be that the Qur’ān is inimitable and thus a miracle from Allāh.

ayahs.translationClear: Saad. By the renowned Quran.

ayahs.textUthmani: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ ۝٢
ayahs.textIndopak: بَلِ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا فِيْ عِزَّةٍ وَّشِقَاقٍ
ayahs.translation: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.
ayahs.transliteration: Balil latheena kafaroo fee 'izzatinw Wa-shiqaaq
ayahs.translationClear: Those who disbelieve are steeped in arrogance and defiance.

ayahs.textUthmani: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ ۝٣
ayahs.textIndopak: كَمْ اَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِّنْ قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوْا وَّلَاتَ حِيْنَ مَنَاصٍ
ayahs.translation: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape.
ayahs.transliteration: Kam ahlaknaa min qablihim min qarnin fanaadaw Wa-laata heena manaas
ayahs.translationClear: How many generations have We destroyed before them? They cried out when it was too late to escape.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا سَـٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ‌ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا سَـٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ ۝٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَعَجِبُوْٓا اَنْ جَا࢜ءَهُمْ مُّنْذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْؗ وَقَالَ الْكٰفِرُوْنَ هٰذَا سٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ ۖۚ
ayahs.translation: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-'ajibooo an jaaa'a-hum munthirum minhum Wa-qaalal kaafiroona haathaa saahirun kaththaab
ayahs.translationClear: And they marveled that a warner has come to them from among them. The disbelievers said, “This is a lying magician.”

ayahs.textUthmani: أَجَعَلَ ٱلْـَٔالِهَةَ إِلَـٰهًا وَٰحِدًا ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَجَعَلَ ٱلْـَٔالِهَةَ إِلَـٰهًا وَٰحِدًا‌ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌ ۝٥
ayahs.textIndopak: اَجَعَلَ الْاٰلِهَةَ اِلٰهًا وَّاحِدًاۚۖ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَشَيْءٌ عُجَابٌ
ayahs.translation: Has he made the gods [only] one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing."
ayahs.transliteration: Aja'alal aalihata Ilaahanw Waahidan inna haathaa lashai'un 'ujaab
ayahs.translationClear: “Did he turn all the gods into one God? This is something strange.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُوا۟ وَٱصْبِرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ يُرَادُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُوا۟ وَٱصْبِرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ‌ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ يُرَادُ ۝٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَانْطَلَقَ الْمَلَاُ مِنْهُمْ اَنِ امْشُوْا وَاصْبِرُوْا عَلٰٓي اٰلِهَتِكُمْۚۖ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَشَيْءٌ يُّرَادُ ۖۚ
ayahs.translation: And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended.[1318]
ayahs.transliteration: Wantalaqal mala-u minhum anim shoo wasbiroo 'alaaa aalihatikum innna haathaa lashai-'uien yuraad

footnotes.1318: Planned by Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) in order to gain influence and prestige for himself.

ayahs.translationClear: The notables among them announced: “Go on, and hold fast to your gods. This is something planned.

ayahs.textUthmani: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَـٰقٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَـٰقٌ ۝٧
ayahs.textIndopak: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهٰذَا فِي الْمِلَّةِ الْاٰخِرَةِۚۖ اِنْ هٰذَا͏ٓ اِلَّا اخْتِلَاقٌ ۖۚ
ayahs.translation: We have not heard of this in the latest religion.[1319] This is not but a fabrication.
ayahs.transliteration: Maa sami'naa bihaathaa fil millatil aakhirati in haathaaa illakh tilaaq

footnotes.1319: Referring to Christianity or possibly the pagan religion of the Quraysh.

ayahs.translationClear: We never heard of this in the former faith. This is nothing but a fabrication.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّن ذِكْرِى ۖ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا‌ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّن ذِكْرِى‌ۖ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ ۝٨
ayahs.textIndopak: ءَاُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ الذِّكْرُ مِنْۢ بَيْنِنَاؕ بَلْ هُمْ فِيْ شَكٍّ مِّنْ ذِكْرِيْۚ بَلْ لَّمَّا يَذُوْقُوْا عَذَابِ ؕ
ayahs.translation: Has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?" Rather, they are in doubt about My message. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: A-unzila 'alaihiz thikru min baininaa; bal hum fee shakkin min Thikree bal lammaa yathooqoo 'athaab
ayahs.translationClear: Was the message sent down to him, out of all of us?” In fact, they are doubtful of My warning. In fact, they have not yet tasted My punishment.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ ۝٩
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمْ عِنْدَهُمْ خَزَا࢜ىِٕنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ الْعَزِيْزِ الْوَهَّابِ ۚ
ayahs.translation: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?[1320]
ayahs.transliteration: Am'indahum khazaaa 'inu rahmati Rabbikal 'Azeezil Wahhab
ayahs.translationClear: Or do they possess the treasuries of the mercy of your Lord—the Majestic, the Giver?

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَـٰبِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا‌ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَـٰبِ ۝١٠
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمْ لَهُمْ مُّلْكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَاࣞ فَلْيَرْتَقُوْا فِي الْاَسْبَابِ
ayahs.translation: Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access.[1321]
ayahs.transliteration: Am lahum mulkus samaawaati wal-ardi Wa-maa bainahumaa falyartaqoo fil asbaab

footnotes.1321: To oversee the affairs of their dominion.

ayahs.translationClear: Or do they possess the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend the ropes.

ayahs.textUthmani: جُندٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: جُندٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ ۝١١
ayahs.textIndopak: جُنْدٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُوْمٌ مِّنَ الْاَحْزَابِ
ayahs.translation: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers].
ayahs.transliteration: Jundum maa hunaalika mahzoomum minal Ahzaab
ayahs.translationClear: An army of confederates will be defeated there.

ayahs.textUthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ ۝١٢
ayahs.textIndopak: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوْحٍ وَّعَادٌ وَّفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو الْاَوْتَادِ ۙ
ayahs.translation: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] ʿAad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes,[1322]
ayahs.transliteration: Kaththabat qablahum qawmu Noohinw Wa-'Aadunw Wa-Fir'awnu thul awtaad
ayahs.translationClear: Before them the people of Noah denied the truth; as did Aad, and Pharaoh of the Stakes.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ‌ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ ۝١٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَثَمُوْدُ وَقَوْمُ لُوْطٍ وَّاَصْحٰبُ لْـٔ͏َيْكَةِؕ اُولٰ࢜ىِٕكَ الْاَحْزَابُ
ayahs.translation: And [the tribe of] Thamūd and the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket [i.e., people of Madyan]. Those are the companies.[1323]
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-Samoodu Wa-qawmu Lootinw Wa-As-haabul 'Aykah; ulaaa'ikal Ahzaab

footnotes.1323: That were defeated, among whom will be the disbelievers of Quraysh and others.

ayahs.translationClear: And Thamood, and the people of Lot, and the dwellers of the Woods—these were the confederates.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ ۝١٤
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنْ كُلٌّ اِلَّا كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified.
ayahs.transliteration: In kullun illaa kaththabar Rusula fahaqqa 'iqaab
ayahs.translationClear: None of them but denied the messengers, so My retribution was deserved.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍ ۝١٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا يَنْظُرُ هٰٓو͏ٔ͏ُلَا࢜ءِ اِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَّاحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِنْ فَوَاقٍ
ayahs.translation: And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay.[1324]
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-maa yanzuru haaa-ulaaa'i illaa saihatanw waahidatam maa lahaa min fawaaq

footnotes.1324: Or "respite." More literally, "a period between two milkings of a she-camel," which also alludes to the meanings of "return" or "repetition."

ayahs.translationClear: These can expect only a single scream, from which there is no recovery.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ ۝١٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقَالُوْا رَبَّنَا عَجِّلْ لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ
ayahs.translation: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account."
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-qaaloo Rabbanaa 'ajjil lanaa qittanaa qabla Yawmil Hisaab
ayahs.translationClear: And they say, “Our Lord, hasten Your writ upon us, before the Day of Account.”

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ‌ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ ۝١٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اِصْبِرْ عَلٰي مَا يَقُوْلُوْنَ وَاذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوٗدَ ذَا الْاَيْدِۚ اِنَّهٗٓ اَوَّابٌ
ayahs.translation: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to Allāh].
ayahs.transliteration: Isbir 'alaa maa yaqooloona wathkur 'abdanaa Daawooda thal aidi innahooo awwaab
ayahs.translationClear: Be patient in the face of what they say, and mention Our servant David, the resourceful. He was obedient.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ ۝١٨
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا الْجِبَالَ مَعَهٗ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَالْاِشْرَاقِ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise.
ayahs.transliteration: Innaa sakhkharnal jibaala ma'ahoo yusabbihna bil'ashiyyi wal-ishraaq
ayahs.translationClear: We committed the mountains to glorify with him, in the evening and at daybreak.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً ۖ كُلٌّ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً‌ۖ كُلٌّ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ ۝١٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالطَّيْرَ مَحْشُوْرَةًؕ كُلٌّ لَّهٗٓ اَوَّابٌ
ayahs.translation: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises].
ayahs.transliteration: Wattayra mahshoorah; kullul lahooo awwaab
ayahs.translationClear: And the birds, gathered together. All obedient to him.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ ۝٢٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهٗ وَاٰتَيْنٰهُ الْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ الْخِطَابِ
ayahs.translation: And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-shadadnaa mulkahoo Wa-aatainaahul Hikmata Wa-faslal khitaab
ayahs.translationClear: And We strengthened his kingdom, and gave him wisdom and decisive speech.

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا۟ ٱلْمِحْرَابَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا۟ ٱلْمِحْرَابَ ۝٢١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَهَلْ اَتٰىكَ نَبَو͏ٔ͏ُا الْخَصْمِۘ اِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا الْمِحْرَابَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of [his] prayer chamber -
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-hal ataaka naba'ul khasm; ith tasawwarul mihraab
ayahs.translationClear: Has the story of the two disputants reached you? When they scaled the sanctuary?

ayahs.textUthmani: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ خَصْمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعْضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَٱهْدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ‌ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ‌ۖ خَصْمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعْضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَٱهْدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ ۝٢٢
ayahs.textIndopak: اِذْ دَخَلُوْا عَلٰي دَاوٗدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ قَالُوْا لَا تَخَفْۚ خَصْمٰنِ بَغٰي بَعْضُنَا عَلٰي بَعْضٍ فَاحْكُمْ بَيْنَنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَاهْدِنَا͏ٓ اِلٰي سَوَا࢜ءِ الصِّرَاطِ
ayahs.translation: When they entered upon David and he was alarmed by them? They said, "Fear not. [We are] two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path.
ayahs.transliteration: Ith dakhaloo 'alaa Daawooda fafazi'a minhum qaaloo laa takhaf khasmaani baghaa ba'dunaa 'alaa ba'din fahkum bainanaaa bilhaqqi Wa-laa tushtit wahdinaaa ilaa Sawaaa'is Siraat
ayahs.translationClear: When they entered upon David, and he was startled by them. They said, “Do not fear. Two disputants; one of us has wronged the other; so judge between us fairly, and do not be biased, and guide us to the straight way.”

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَآ أَخِى لَهُۥ تِسْعٌ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةً وَلِىَ نَعْجَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِى فِى ٱلْخِطَابِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ هَـٰذَآ أَخِى لَهُۥ تِسْعٌ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةً وَلِىَ نَعْجَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِى فِى ٱلْخِطَابِ ۝٢٣
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ هٰذَا͏ٓ اَخِيْࣞ لَهٗ تِسْعٌ وَّتِسْعُوْنَ نَعْجَةً وَّلِيَ نَعْجَةٌ وَّاحِدَةٌࣞ فَقَالَ اَكْفِلْنِيْهَا وَعَزَّنِيْ فِي الْخِطَابِ
ayahs.translation: Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech."
ayahs.transliteration: Inna haathaaa akhee lahoo tis'unw Wa-tis'oona na'jatanw Wa-liya na'jatunw waahidah; faqaala akfilneeha Wa-'azzanee fil khitaab
ayahs.translationClear: “This brother of mine has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe, and he said, ‘Entrust it to me,’ and he pressured me with words.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦ ۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلْخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبْغِى بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَقَلِيلٌ مَّا هُمْ ۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّـٰهُ فَٱسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًا وَأَنَابَ ۩
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦ‌ۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلْخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبْغِى بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَقَلِيلٌ مَّا هُمْ‌ۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّـٰهُ فَٱسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًا وَأَنَابَ ۩ ۝٢٤
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُو͏ٔ͏َالِ نَعْجَتِكَ اِلٰي نِعَاجِهٖؕ وَاِنَّ كَثِيْرًا مِّنَ الْخُلَطَا࢜ءِ لَيَبْغِيْ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلٰي بَعْضٍ اِلَّا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَقَلِيْلٌ مَّا هُمْؕ وَظَنَّ دَاوٗدُ اَنَّمَا فَتَنّٰهُ فَاسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهٗ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًا وَّاَنَابَ ࣛ
ayahs.translation: [David] said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord[1325] and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allāh].
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala laqad zalamaka bisu-'aali na'jatika ilaa ni'aajih; Wa-inna kaseeran minal khulataaa'i la-yabghee ba'duhum 'alaa ba'din illal latheena aamanoo Wa-'amilus saalihaati Wa-qaleelun maa hum; Wa-zanna Daawoodu annamaa fatannaahu fastaghfara Rabbahoo Wa-kharra raaki'anw Wa-anaab

footnotes.1325: For his errors, such as fear and suspicion of the two men at the outset, any mistake in judgement he might have made, concealed feelings of partiality, etc.

ayahs.translationClear: He said, “He has done you wrong by asking your ewe in addition to his ewes. Many partners take advantage of one another, except those who believe and do good deeds, but these are so few.” David realized that We were testing him, so he sought forgiveness from his Lord, and fell down to his knees, and repented.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَ‌ۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ ۝٢٥
ayahs.textIndopak: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهٗ ذٰلِكَؕ وَاِنَّ لَهٗ عِنْدَنَا لَزُلْفٰي وَحُسْنَ مَاٰبٍ
ayahs.translation: So We forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
ayahs.transliteration: Faghafarnaa lahoo thaalik; Wa-inna lahoo 'indanaa lazulfaa Wa-husna ma-aab
ayahs.translationClear: So We forgave him that. And for him is nearness to Us, and a good place of return.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَـٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَـٰكَ خَلِيفَةً فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌۢ بِمَا نَسُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْحِسَابِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَـٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَـٰكَ خَلِيفَةً فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ‌ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌۢ بِمَا نَسُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْحِسَابِ ۝٢٦
ayahs.textIndopak: يٰدَاوٗدُ اِنَّا جَعَلْنٰكَ خَلِيْفَةً فِي الْاَرْضِ فَاحْكُمْ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ الْهَوٰي فَيُضِلَّكَ عَنْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِؕ اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ يَضِلُّوْنَ عَنْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيْدٌۢ بِمَا نَسُوْا يَوْمَ الْحِسَابِ ࣖ

words.translation: for it will lead you astray

ayahs.translation: [We said], "O David, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allāh." Indeed, those who go astray from the way of Allāh will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account.
ayahs.transliteration: Yaa-Daawoodu innaa ja'alnaaka khaleefatan fil ardi fahkum bainan naasi bilhaqqi Wa-laa tattabi'il hawaa fayudillaka 'an sabeelil laah; innal latheena yadilloona 'an sabeelil laah; lahum 'athaabun shadeedum bimaa nasoo Yawmal Hisaab
ayahs.translationClear: “O David, We made you a ruler in the land, so judge between the people with justice, and do not follow desire, lest it diverts you from Allah’s path. Those who stray from Allah’s path will have a painful punishment, for having ignored the Day of Account.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَـٰطِلًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَـٰطِلًا‌ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟‌ۚ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ ۝٢٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَا࢜ءَ وَالْاَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَاطِلًاؕ ذٰلِكَ ظَنُّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْاۚ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا مِنَ النَّارِ ؕ
ayahs.translation: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-maa khalaqnas samaaa'a wal-arda Wa-maa bainahumaa baatilaa; thaalika zannul latheena kafaroo; fa-waylul lil-latheena kafaroo minan Naar
ayahs.translationClear: We did not create the heaven and the earth and everything between them in vain. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve—so woe to those who disbelieve because of the Fire.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ كَٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلْفُجَّارِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ كَٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلْفُجَّارِ ۝٢٨
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمْ نَجْعَلُ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ كَالْمُفْسِدِيْنَ فِي الْاَرْضِؗ اَمْ نَجْعَلُ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ كَالْفُجَّارِ
ayahs.translation: Or should We treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the land? Or should We treat those who fear Allāh like the wicked?
ayahs.transliteration: Am naj'alul latheena aamanoo Wa-'amilus saalihaati kalmufisdeena fil ardi am naj'alul muttaqeena kalfujjaar
ayahs.translationClear: Or are We to treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like those who make trouble on earth? Or are We to treat the pious like the shameless?

ayahs.textUthmani: كِتَـٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَـٰرَكٌ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓا۟ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كِتَـٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَـٰرَكٌ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓا۟ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ ۝٢٩
ayahs.textIndopak: كِتٰبٌ اَنْزَلْنٰهُ اِلَيْكَ مُبٰرَكٌ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوْٓا اٰيٰتِهٖ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ اُولُوا الْاَلْبَابِ
ayahs.translation: [This is] a blessed Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded.
ayahs.transliteration: Kitaabun anzalnaahu ilaika mubaarakul liyaddabbarooo Aayaatihee Wa-liyatathakkara ulul albaab
ayahs.translationClear: A blessed Book that We sent down to you, that they may ponder its Verses, and for those with intelligence to take heed.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ ۚ نِعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ‌ۚ نِعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ‌ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ ۝٣٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوٗدَ سُلَيْمٰنَؕ نِعْمَ الْعَبْدُؕ اِنَّهٗٓ اَوَّابٌ ؕ
ayahs.translation: And to David We gave Solomon. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allāh].
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-wahabnaa li-Daawooda Sulaimaan; ni'mal 'abd; innahoo awwaab
ayahs.translationClear: And We granted David, Solomon, an excellent servant. He was penitent.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ ٱلصَّـٰفِنَـٰتُ ٱلْجِيَادُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ ٱلصَّـٰفِنَـٰتُ ٱلْجِيَادُ ۝٣١
ayahs.textIndopak: اِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِالْعَشِيِّ الصّٰفِنٰتُ الْجِيَادُ ۙ
ayahs.translation: [Mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses.
ayahs.transliteration: Ith 'urida 'alaihi bil'ashiy-yis saafinaatul jiyaad
ayahs.translationClear: When the beautiful horses were paraded before him in the evening.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ ۝٣٢
ayahs.textIndopak: فَقَالَ اِنِّيْٓ اَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ الْخَيْرِ عَنْ ذِكْرِ رَبِّيْۚ حَتّٰي تَوَارَتْ بِالْحِجَابِ ࣟ
ayahs.translation: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until it [i.e., the sun] disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]."
ayahs.transliteration: Faqaala inneee ahbabtu hubbal khairi 'an thikri Rabbee hattaa tawaarat bilhijaab
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “I have preferred the love of niceties to the remembrance of my Lord—until it disappeared behind the veil.

ayahs.textUthmani: رُدُّوهَا عَلَىَّ ۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلْأَعْنَاقِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: رُدُّوهَا عَلَىَّ‌ۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلْأَعْنَاقِ ۝٣٣
ayahs.textIndopak: رُدُّوْهَا عَلَيَّؕ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًاۢ بِالسُّوْقِ وَالْاَعْنَاقِ
ayahs.translation: [He said], "Return them to me," and set about striking[1326] [their] legs and necks.
ayahs.transliteration: Ruddoohaa 'alaiya fa-tafiqa mas-ham bissooqi wal-a'naaq

footnotes.1326: With his sword as expiation. Some commentaries have also suggested the meaning of "stroking" with the hand.

ayahs.translationClear: Bring them back to me.” And he began caressing their legs and necks.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَـٰنَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَىٰ كُرْسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَـٰنَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَىٰ كُرْسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ ۝٣٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمٰنَ وَاَلْقَيْنَا عَلٰي كُرْسِيِّهٖ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ اَنَابَ
ayahs.translation: And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body;[1327] then he returned.[1328]
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-laqad fatannaa Sulaimaana Wa-alqainaa 'alaa kursiyyihee jasadan summa anaab

footnotes.1327: Said to be a devil or a lifeless body (one without capability), but Allāh alone knows.
footnotes.1328: To sovereignty and to Allāh in repentance.

ayahs.translationClear: We tested Solomon, and placed a body on his throne; then he repented.

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَهَبْ لِى مُلْكًا لَّا يَنۢبَغِى لِأَحَدٍ مِّنۢ بَعْدِىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَهَبْ لِى مُلْكًا لَّا يَنۢبَغِى لِأَحَدٍ مِّنۢ بَعْدِىٓ‌ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ ۝٣٥
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِيْ وَهَبْ لِيْ مُلْكًا لَّا يَنۢ͏ْبَغِيْ لِاَحَدٍ مِّنْۢ بَعْدِيْۚ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ
ayahs.translation: He said, "My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala Rabbigh fir lee Wa-hab lee mulkal laa yambaghee li-ahadin min ba'dee innaka Antal Wahhaab
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “My Lord, forgive me, and grant me a kingdom never to be attained by anyone after me. You are the Giver.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ ۝٣٦
ayahs.textIndopak: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ الرِّيْحَ تَجْرِيْ بِاَمْرِهٖ رُخَا࢜ءً حَيْثُ اَصَابَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed,
ayahs.transliteration: Fa-sakharnaa lahur reeha tajree bi-amrihee rukhaaa'an haisu asaab
ayahs.translationClear: So We placed the wind at his service, blowing gently by his command, wherever he directed.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلشَّيَـٰطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٍ وَغَوَّاصٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلشَّيَـٰطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٍ وَغَوَّاصٍ ۝٣٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالشَّيٰطِيْنَ كُلَّ بَنَّا࢜ءٍ وَّغَوَّاصٍ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And [also] the devils [of jinn] - every builder and diver
ayahs.transliteration: Wash-Shayaateena kulla bannaaa'inw Wa-ghawwaas
ayahs.translationClear: And the demons—every builder and diver.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِى ٱلْأَصْفَادِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِى ٱلْأَصْفَادِ ۝٣٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّاٰخَرِيْنَ مُقَرَّنِيْنَ فِي الْاَصْفَادِ
ayahs.translation: And others bound together in irons.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-aakhareena muqarraneena fil asfaad
ayahs.translationClear: And others fettered in chains.

ayahs.textUthmani: هَـٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: هَـٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ ۝٣٩
ayahs.textIndopak: هٰذَا عَطَا࢜و͏ٔ͏ُنَا فَامْنُنْ اَوْ اَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
ayahs.translation: [We said], "This is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account."
ayahs.transliteration: Haathaa 'ataaa'unaa famnun aw amsik bighairi hisaab
ayahs.translationClear: “This is Our gift; so give generously, or withhold; without account.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ ۝٤٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِنَّ لَهٗ عِنْدَنَا لَزُلْفٰي وَحُسْنَ مَاٰبٍ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-inna lahoo 'indanaa lazulfaa Wa-husna ma-aab
ayahs.translationClear: For him is nearness to Us, and a beautiful resort.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍ وَعَذَابٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍ وَعَذَابٍ ۝٤١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا͏ٓ اَيُّوْبَۘ اِذْ نَادٰي رَبَّهٗٓ اَنِّيْ مَسَّنِيَ الشَّيْطٰنُ بِنُصْبٍ وَّعَذَابٍ ؕ
ayahs.translation: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment."
ayahs.transliteration: Wathkur 'abdanaaa Ayyoob; ith naada Rabbahooo annee massaniyash Shaitaanu bi-nusbinw Wa-'athaab
ayahs.translationClear: And mention Our servant Job, when he called out to his Lord, “Satan has afflicted me with hardship and pain.”

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۖ هَـٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌ وَشَرَابٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ‌ۖ هَـٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌ وَشَرَابٌ ۝٤٢
ayahs.textIndopak: اُرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَۚ هٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌ وَّشَرَابٌ

words.translation: (is a spring of) water to bathe

ayahs.translation: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for a] cool bath and drink."
ayahs.transliteration: Urkud bi-rijlika haatha mughtasalun baaridunw Wa-sharaab
ayahs.translationClear: “Stamp with your foot—here is cool water to wash with, and to drink.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ ۝٤٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهٗٓ اَهْلَهٗ وَمِثْلَهُمْ مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَذِكْرٰي لِاُولِي الْاَلْبَابِ
ayahs.translation: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-wahabnaa lahoo ahlahoo Wa-mislahum ma'ahum rahmatan minna Wa-thikraa li-ulil albaab
ayahs.translationClear: And We restored his family for him, and their like with them; as a mercy from Us, and a lesson for those who possess insight.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًا فَٱضْرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ ۗ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَـٰهُ صَابِرًا ۚ نِّعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًا فَٱضْرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ‌ۗ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَـٰهُ صَابِرًا‌ۚ نِّعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ‌ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ ۝٤٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًا فَاضْرِبْ بِّهٖ وَلَا تَحْنَثْؕ اِنَّا وَجَدْنٰهُ صَابِرًاؕ نِعْمَ الْعَبْدُؕ اِنَّهٗٓ اَوَّابٌ
ayahs.translation: [We said], "And take in your hand a bunch [of grass] and strike with it and do not break your oath."[1329] Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allāh].
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-khuth biyadika dighsan fadrib bihee Wa-laa tahnas, innaa wajadnaahu saabiraa; ni'mal 'abd; innahooo awwaab

footnotes.1329: At a point during his illness, Job became angry with his wife and swore that if he recovered, he would punish her with one hundred lashes. According to Allāh's instruction, the oath was fulfilled by striking her once with one hundred blades of grass.

ayahs.translationClear: “Take with your hand a bundle, and strike with it, and do not break your oath.” We found him patient. What an excellent servant! He was obedient.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱذْكُرْ عِبَـٰدَنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُو۟لِى ٱلْأَيْدِى وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱذْكُرْ عِبَـٰدَنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُو۟لِى ٱلْأَيْدِى وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرِ ۝٤٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاذْكُرْ عِبٰدَنَا͏ٓ اِبْرٰهِيْمَ وَاِسْحٰقَ وَيَعْقُوْبَ اُولِي الْاَيْدِيْ وَالْاَبْصَارِ
ayahs.translation: And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob - those of strength and [religious] vision.
ayahs.transliteration: Wathkur 'ibaadanaaa Ibraaheema Wa-Is-haaqa Wa-Ya'qooba ulil aydee walabsaar
ayahs.translationClear: And mention Our servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—endowed with ability and vision.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّآ أَخْلَصْنَـٰهُم بِخَالِصَةٍ ذِكْرَى ٱلدَّارِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّآ أَخْلَصْنَـٰهُم بِخَالِصَةٍ ذِكْرَى ٱلدَّارِ ۝٤٦
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّا͏ٓ اَخْلَصْنٰهُمْ بِخَالِصَةٍ ذِكْرَي الدَّارِ ۚ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home [of the Hereafter].
ayahs.transliteration: Innaaa akhlasnaahum bi-khaalisatin thikrad daar
ayahs.translationClear: We distinguished them with a distinct quality: the remembrance of the Home.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِنَّهُمْ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصْطَفَيْنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِنَّهُمْ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصْطَفَيْنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ ۝٤٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِنَّهُمْ عِنْدَنَا لَمِنَ الْمُصْطَفَيْنَ الْاَخْيَارِ ؕ
ayahs.translation: And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-innahum 'indanaa laminal mustafainal akhyaar
ayahs.translationClear: To Us they are among the chosen, the outstanding.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱذْكُرْ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَٱلْيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ وَكُلٌّ مِّنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱذْكُرْ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَٱلْيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ‌ۖ وَكُلٌّ مِّنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ ۝٤٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاذْكُرْ اِسْمٰعِيْلَ وَالْيَسَعَ وَذَا الْكِفْلِؕ وَكُلٌّ مِّنَ الْاَخْيَارِ ؕ
ayahs.translation: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding.
ayahs.transliteration: Wathkur Ismaa'eela wal Yasa'a Wa-Zal-Kifli Wa-kullun minal akhyaar
ayahs.translationClear: And mention Ishmael, Elisha, and Ezekiel; all are among the outstanding.

ayahs.textUthmani: هَـٰذَا ذِكْرٌ ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: هَـٰذَا ذِكْرٌ‌ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ ۝٤٩
ayahs.textIndopak: هٰذَا ذِكْرٌؕ وَاِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِيْنَ لَحُسْنَ مَاٰبٍ ۙ
ayahs.translation: This is a reminder. And indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return -
ayahs.transliteration: Haathaa thikrun Wa-inna lil-muttaqeena la-husna ma-aab
ayahs.translationClear: This is a reminder. The devout will have a good place of return.

ayahs.textUthmani: جَنَّـٰتِ عَدْنٍ مُّفَتَّحَةً لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَبْوَٰبُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: جَنَّـٰتِ عَدْنٍ مُّفَتَّحَةً لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَبْوَٰبُ ۝٥٠
ayahs.textIndopak: جَنّٰتِ عَدْنٍ مُّفَتَّحَةً لَّهُمُ الْاَبْوَابُ ۚ
ayahs.translation: Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them.
ayahs.transliteration: Jannaati 'adnin mufattahatan lahumul abwaab
ayahs.translationClear: The Gardens of Eden, with their doors wide-open for them.

ayahs.textUthmani: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَـٰكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ وَشَرَابٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَـٰكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ وَشَرَابٍ ۝٥١
ayahs.textIndopak: مُتَّكِـِٕيْنَ فِيْهَا يَدْعُوْنَ فِيْهَا بِفَاكِهَةٍ كَثِيْرَةٍ وَّشَرَابٍ
ayahs.translation: Reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink.
ayahs.transliteration: Muttaki'eena feehaa yad'oona feehaa bifaakihatin kaseeratinw Wa-sharaab
ayahs.translationClear: Relaxing therein, and calling for abundant fruit and beverage.

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ وَعِندَهُمْ قَـٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ أَتْرَابٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ وَعِندَهُمْ قَـٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ أَتْرَابٌ ۝٥٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَعِنْدَهُمْ قٰصِرٰتُ الطَّرْفِ اَتْرَابٌ
ayahs.translation: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances[1330] and of equal age.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-'indahum qaasiraatut tarfi atraab
ayahs.translationClear: With them will be attendants with modest gaze, of same age.

ayahs.textUthmani: هَـٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: هَـٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ ۝٥٣
ayahs.textIndopak: هٰذَا مَا تُوْعَدُوْنَ لِيَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ
ayahs.translation: This is what you, [the righteous], are promised for the Day of Account.
ayahs.transliteration: Haathaa maa too'adoona li-Yawmil Hisaab
ayahs.translationClear: This is what you are promised for the Day of Account.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ ۝٥٤
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ هٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهٗ مِنْ نَّفَادٍ ۚۖ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, this is Our provision; for it there is no depletion.
ayahs.transliteration: Inna haathaa larizqunaa maa lahoo min nafaad
ayahs.translationClear: Such is Our bounty, inexhaustible.

ayahs.textUthmani: هَـٰذَا ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلطَّـٰغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَـَٔابٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: هَـٰذَا‌ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلطَّـٰغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَـَٔابٍ ۝٥٥
ayahs.textIndopak: هٰذَاؕ وَاِنَّ لِلطّٰغِيْنَ لَشَرَّ مَاٰبٍ ۙ
ayahs.translation: This [is so]. But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return -
ayahs.transliteration: Haathaa; Wa-inna littaagheena lasharra ma-aab
ayahs.translationClear: All this. But the transgressors will have a miserable return.

ayahs.textUthmani: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ ۝٥٦
ayahs.textIndopak: جَهَنَّمَۚ يَصْلَوْنَهَاۚ فَبِي͏ٔ͏ْسَ الْمِهَادُ
ayahs.translation: Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the resting place.
ayahs.transliteration: Jahannama yaslawnahaa fa-bi'sal mihaad
ayahs.translationClear: Hell; in which they will roast; what a miserable abode!

ayahs.textUthmani: هَـٰذَا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌ وَغَسَّاقٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: هَـٰذَا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌ وَغَسَّاقٌ ۝٥٧
ayahs.textIndopak: هٰذَاۙ فَلْيَذُوْقُوْهُ حَمِيْمٌ وَّغَسَّاقٌ ۙ
ayahs.translation: This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence.
ayahs.transliteration: Haathaa falyathooqoohu hameemunw Wa-ghassaaq
ayahs.translationClear: All this. Let them taste it—boiling and bitter cold.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَءَاخَرُ مِن شَكْلِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَءَاخَرُ مِن شَكْلِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجٌ ۝٥٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّاٰخَرُ مِنْ شَكْلِهٖٓ اَزْوَاجٌ ؕ
ayahs.translation: And other [punishments] of its type [in various] kinds.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-aakharu min shakliheee azwaaj
ayahs.translationClear: And similar torments of diverse kinds.

ayahs.textUthmani: هَـٰذَا فَوْجٌ مُّقْتَحِمٌ مَّعَكُمْ ۖ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُوا۟ ٱلنَّارِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: هَـٰذَا فَوْجٌ مُّقْتَحِمٌ مَّعَكُمْ‌ۖ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِهِمْ‌ۚ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُوا۟ ٱلنَّارِ ۝٥٩
ayahs.textIndopak: هٰذَا فَوْجٌ مُّقْتَحِمٌ مَّعَكُمْۚ لَا مَرْحَبًاۢ بِهِمْؕ اِنَّهُمْ صَالُوا النَّارِ
ayahs.translation: [Its inhabitants will say], "This is a company bursting in with you. No welcome for them. Indeed, they will burn in the Fire."
ayahs.transliteration: Haathaa fawjun muqtahimun ma'akum laa marhaban bihim; innahum saalun Naar
ayahs.translationClear: “This is a crowd rushing headlong with you.” There is no welcome for them. They will be scorched by the Fire.

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ أَنتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِكُمْ ۖ أَنتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرَارُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ أَنتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِكُمْ‌ۖ أَنتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا‌ۖ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرَارُ ۝٦٠
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْا بَلْ اَنْتُمْࣞ لَا مَرْحَبًاۢ بِكُمْؕ اَنْتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوْهُ لَنَاۚ فَبِي͏ٔ͏ْسَ الْقَرَارُ
ayahs.translation: They will say, "Nor you! No welcome for you. You, [our leaders], brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo bal antum laa marhaban bikum; antum qaddamtumoohu lanaa fabi'sal qaraar
ayahs.translationClear: They will say, “But it is you! There is no welcome for you! It is you who brought it upon us! What a miserable end!”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَـٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا فِى ٱلنَّارِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَـٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا فِى ٱلنَّارِ ۝٦١
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْا رَبَّنَا مَنْ قَدَّمَ لَنَا هٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا فِي النَّارِ
ayahs.translation: They will say, "Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the Fire."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo Rabbanaa man qaddama lanaa haathaa fa-zidhu 'athaaban di'fan fin Naar
ayahs.translationClear: They will say, “Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us, give him double torment in the Fire.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالًا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقَالُوا۟ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالًا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ ۝٦٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقَالُوْا مَا لَنَا لَا نَرٰي رِجَالًا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُمْ مِّنَ الْاَشْرَارِ ؕ
ayahs.translation: And they will say, "Why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst?[1331]
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-qaaloo maa lanaa laa naraa rijaalan kunnaa na'udduhum minal ashraar

footnotes.1331: They are referring to the believers.

ayahs.translationClear: And they will say, “What is it with us that we do not see men we used to count among the wicked?

ayahs.textUthmani: أَتَّخَذْنَـٰهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا أَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَتَّخَذْنَـٰهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا أَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرُ ۝٦٣
ayahs.textIndopak: اَتَّخَذْنٰهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا اَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ الْاَبْصَارُ
ayahs.translation: Is it [because] we took them in ridicule, or has [our] vision turned away from them?"
ayahs.transliteration: Attakhathnaahum sikh-riyyan am zaaghat 'anhumul absaar
ayahs.translationClear: Did we take them for mockery, or have our eyes swerved from them?”

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّ تَخَاصُمُ أَهْلِ ٱلنَّارِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّ تَخَاصُمُ أَهْلِ ٱلنَّارِ ۝٦٤
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ ذٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّ تَخَاصُمُ اَهْلِ النَّارِ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, that is truth [i.e., reality] - the quarreling of the people of the Fire.
ayahs.transliteration: Inna thaalika lahaqqun takhaasumu Ahlin Naar
ayahs.translationClear: This is certainly true—the feuding of the people of the Fire.

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مُنذِرٌ ۖ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَـٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مُنذِرٌ‌ۖ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَـٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ ۝٦٥
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ اِنَّمَا͏ٓ اَنَا مُنْذِرٌࣗۖ وَّمَا مِنْ اِلٰهٍ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ ۚ
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I am only a warner, and there is not any deity except Allāh, the One, the Prevailing,[1332]
ayahs.transliteration: Qul innamaaa ana munthirunw Wa-maa min laahin illal laahul Waahidul Qahhaar
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “I am only a warner, and there is no god except Allah—the One, the Conqueror.

ayahs.textUthmani: رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّـٰرُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّـٰرُ ۝٦٦
ayahs.textIndopak: رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الْعَزِيْزُ الْغَفَّارُ
ayahs.translation: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Exalted in Might,[1333] the Perpetual Forgiver."[1334]
ayahs.transliteration: Rabbus samaawaati wal-ardi Wa-maa bainahumal 'Azeezul Ghaffaar

footnotes.1333: Honored for absolute power associated with wisdom and justice.
footnotes.1334: Who continually conceals sins and faults.

ayahs.translationClear: The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them; the Mighty, the Forgiver.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَؤٌا۟ عَظِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَؤٌا۟ عَظِيمٌ ۝٦٧
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَو͏ٔ͏ٌا عَظِيْمٌ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Say, "It is great news
ayahs.transliteration: Qul huwa naba'un 'azeem
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “It is a message of great importance.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَنتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَنتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ ۝٦٨
ayahs.textIndopak: اَنْتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: From which you turn away.
ayahs.transliteration: Antum 'anhu mu'ridoon
ayahs.translationClear: From which you are turning away.

ayahs.textUthmani: مَا كَانَ لِىَ مِنْ عِلْمٍۭ بِٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰٓ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مَا كَانَ لِىَ مِنْ عِلْمٍۭ بِٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰٓ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ ۝٦٩
ayahs.textIndopak: مَا كَانَ لِيَ مِنْ عِلْمٍۭ بِالْمَلَاِ الْاَعْلٰٓي اِذْ يَخْتَصِمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: I had no knowledge of the exalted assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [the creation of Adam].
ayahs.transliteration: Maa kaana liya min 'ilmin bil-mala'il a'laaa ith yakhtasimoon
ayahs.translationClear: I have no knowledge of the Highest Assembly as they dispute.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِن يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ إِلَّآ أَنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِن يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ إِلَّآ أَنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ ۝٧٠
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنْ يُّوْحٰٓي اِلَيَّ اِلَّا͏ٓ اَنَّمَا͏ٓ اَنَا نَذِيْرٌ مُّبِيْنٌ
ayahs.translation: It has not been revealed to me except that I am a clear warner."
ayahs.transliteration: Ien-yoohaaa ilaiya illaaa anna maaa ana natheerun mubeen
ayahs.translationClear: It is only revealed to me that I am a clear warner.”

ayahs.textUthmani: إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَـٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّن طِينٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَـٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّن طِينٍ ۝٧١
ayahs.textIndopak: اِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةِ اِنِّيْ خَالِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّنْ طِيْنٍ
ayahs.translation: [So mention] when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay.
ayahs.transliteration: Ith qaala Rabbuka lilmalaaa'ikati innee khaaliqun basharan min teen
ayahs.translationClear: Your Lord said to the angels, “I am creating a human being from clay.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَـٰجِدِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَـٰجِدِينَ ۝٧٢
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاِذَا سَوَّيْتُهٗ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيْهِ مِنْ رُّوْحِيْ فَقَعُوْا لَهٗ سٰجِدِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul,[1335] then fall down to him in prostration."
ayahs.transliteration: Fa-itha sawwaituhoo Wa-nafakhtu feehi mir roohee faqa'oo lahoo saajideen
ayahs.translationClear: When I have formed him, and breathed into him of My spirit, fall prostrate before him.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ ۝٧٣
ayahs.textIndopak: فَسَجَدَ الْمَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ اَجْمَعُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,
ayahs.transliteration: Fasajadal malaaa'ikatu kulluhum ajma'oon
ayahs.translationClear: So the angels fell prostrate, all of them.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ ٱسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ ٱسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ ۝٧٤
ayahs.textIndopak: اِلَّا͏ٓ اِبْلِيْسَؕ اِسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Except Iblees;[1336] he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers.
ayahs.transliteration: Illaaa Iblees; stakbara Wa-kaana minal kaafireen
ayahs.translationClear: Except for Satan. He was too proud, and one of the faithless.

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ يَـٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَىَّ ۖ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْعَالِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ يَـٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَىَّ‌ۖ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْعَالِينَ ۝٧٥
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ يٰٓاِبْلِيْسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ اَنْ تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَيَّؕ اَسْتَكْبَرْتَ اَمْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الْعَالِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: [Allāh] said, "O Iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My hands?[1337] Were you arrogant [then], or were you [already] among the haughty?"
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala yaaa-Ibleesu maa mana'aka an tasjuda limaa khalaqtu bi-yadaiyya-'a stakbarta am kunta min al-'aaleen
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “O Satan, what prevented you from prostrating before what I created with My own hands? Are you too proud, or were you one of the exalted?”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌ مِّنْهُ ۖ خَلَقْتَنِى مِن نَّارٍ وَخَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن طِينٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌ مِّنْهُ‌ۖ خَلَقْتَنِى مِن نَّارٍ وَخَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن طِينٍ ۝٧٦
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ اَنَا خَيْرٌ مِّنْهُؕ خَلَقْتَنِيْ مِنْ نَّارٍ وَّخَلَقْتَهٗ مِنْ طِيْنٍ
ayahs.translation: He said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala ana khairum minhu; khalaqtanee min naarinw Wa-khalaqtahoo min teen
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “I am better than he; You created me from fire, and You created him from clay.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ ۝٧٧
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ فَاخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَاِنَّكَ رَجِيْمٌ ۚۖ
ayahs.translation: [Allāh] said, "Then get out of it [i.e., Paradise], for indeed, you are expelled.
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala fakhruj minhaa fa-innaka rajeem
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “Then get out of here! You are an outcast!

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ ۝٧٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّاِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِيْٓ اِلٰي يَوْمِ الدِّيْنِ
ayahs.translation: And indeed, upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense."
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-inna 'alaika la'nateee ilaa Yawmid Deen
ayahs.translationClear: And My curse will be upon you until the Day of Judgment.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ ۝٧٩
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ رَبِّ فَاَنْظِرْنِيْٓ اِلٰي يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala Rabbi fa-anzirneee ilaa Yawmi yub'asoon
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “Lord, defer me until the Day they are resurrected.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ ۝٨٠
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ فَاِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنْظَرِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: [Allāh] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala fa-innaka minal munzareen
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “You are one of those deferred.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ ۝٨١
ayahs.textIndopak: اِلٰي يَوْمِ الْوَقْتِ الْمَعْلُوْمِ
ayahs.translation: Until the Day of the time well-known."
ayahs.transliteration: Ilaa Yawmil waqtil ma'loom
ayahs.translationClear: Until the Day of the time appointed.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ ۝٨٢
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَاُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: [Iblees] said, "By Your might, I will surely mislead them all
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala fa-bi-'izzatika la-ughwiyannahum ajma'een
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “By Your majesty, I will seduce them all.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ ۝٨٣
ayahs.textIndopak: اِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ الْمُخْلَصِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."
ayahs.transliteration: Illaa 'ibaadaka minhumul mukhlaseen
ayahs.translationClear: Except for Your loyal servants among them.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ فَٱلْحَقُّ وَٱلْحَقَّ أَقُولُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ فَٱلْحَقُّ وَٱلْحَقَّ أَقُولُ ۝٨٤
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ فَالْحَقُّؗ وَالْحَقَّ اَقُوْلُ ۚ
ayahs.translation: [Allāh] said, "The truth [is My oath], and the truth I say -
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala falhaqq, walhaqqa aqool
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “The truth is, and I say the truth.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ ۝٨٥
ayahs.textIndopak: لَاَمْلَـٔ͏َنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنْكَ وَمِمَّنْ تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: [That] I will surely fill Hell with you and those of them that follow you all together."
ayahs.transliteration: La-amla'anna Jahannama minka Wa-mimman tabi'aka minhum ajma'een
ayahs.translationClear: I will fill Hell with you, and with every one of them who follows you.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ ۝٨٦
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ مَا͏ٓ اَسْـٔ͏َلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍ وَّمَا͏ٓ اَنَا مِنَ الْمُتَكَلِّفِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I do not ask you for it [i.e., the Qur’ān] any payment, and I am not of the pretentious.
ayahs.transliteration: Qul maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrinw Wa-maaa ana minal mutakallifeen
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “I ask of you no wage for this, and I am not a pretender.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ ۝٨٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنْ هُوَ اِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعٰلَمِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: It is but a reminder to the worlds.
ayahs.transliteration: In huwa illaa thikrul lil'aalameen
ayahs.translationClear: It is but a reminder to mankind.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُۥ بَعْدَ حِينٍۭ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُۥ بَعْدَ حِينٍۭ ۝٨٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَاَهٗ بَعْدَ حِيْنٍ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: And you will surely know [the truth of] its information after a time."
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-lata'lamunna naba-ahoo ba'da heen
ayahs.translationClear: And you will know its message after a while.”
